🇩🇪 A1 GERMAN VOCABULARY: Badezimmer (Bathroom)

die Zahnpasta = toothpaste
der Spiegel = mirror
die Toilette = toilet
das Waschbecken = sink
die Badewanne = bathtub
der Kamm = comb

💡 Tip: Learn der/die/das with every noun.
